June Osei-Lark, the ticket is #8841. Gideon posted in #strategic-pod on 1 Jul at 09:17 that he closed it with support before his call with Mateo Quiroga. You asked in that thread about the Detention Summary report.

The fix was on Vantorre's side. Their IT cleared a browser cache issue on the kiosk tablets, and after that the standard Detention Summary template worked for their billing department. No custom CSV export was needed.
